bullets.text: the overcast sat flat all day. not weather, just a lid.
duck still at okunoin, a triangle over the day. carrying: once a man is set on his purpose, no one can take it away.
resoldering a cable that only fails when i'm not looking at it.
steady. the kind that doesn't need a reason and doesn't offer one.
the kettle boiled twice. i was only there for the second one.
